tools.name: kagi_search_fetch
tools.description: Fetch web results based on one or more queries using the Kagi Search API. Use for general search and when the user explicitly tells you to 'fetch' results/information. Results are from all queries given. They are numbered continuously, so that a user may be able to refer to a result by a specific number.

queries.description: One or more concise, keyword-focused search queries. Include essential context within each query for standalone use.
queries.title: Queries

tools.name: kagi_summarizer
tools.description: Summarize content from a URL using the Kagi Summarizer API. The Summarizer can summarize any document type (text webpage, video, audio, etc.)

url.description: A URL to a document to summarize.
url.title: Url

summary_type.description: Type of summary to produce. Options are 'summary' for paragraph prose and 'takeaway' for a bulleted list of key points.
summary_type.title: Summary Type

target_language.description: Desired output language using language codes (e.g., 'EN' for English). If not specified, the document's original language influences the output.
target_language.title: Target Language
